name: DescribeSQLLogCount

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html operation to query the information about all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances within a region, including instance IDs
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html接口查看目标地域下所有的AnalyticDB PostgreSQL版实例的详情，包括实例ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The keywords that are used to query audit logs
parameters.name: query_keywords

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The name of the database account that is used to connect to the database
parameters.name: user

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC.

The end time must be later than the start time. The maximum time range that can be specified is seven days
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间。格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）。 查询结束时间需晚于开始时间，且开始时间和结束时间的时间间隔不能超过七天
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The execution duration of the SQL statement. Unit: seconds
parameters.name: execute_cost

parameters.help_en:
The execution status of the query. Valid values:

1: successful.
0: failed.
0,1 or 1,0: all
parameters.help_zh:
执行状态。取值如下：

取值为1：成功
取值为0：失败
取值为0,1或1,0：全部
parameters.name: execute_state

parameters.help_en:
The type of the query language. Valid values:

DQL
DML
DDL
DCL
TCL
parameters.help_zh:
操作类别。取值如下：

DQL
DML
DDL
DCL
TCL
parameters.name: operation_class

parameters.help_en:
The type of the SQL statement.



If you specify OperationClass, the value of OperationType must be of the corresponding query language. For example, if you set OperationClass to DQL, the value of OperationType must be a DQL statement such as SELECT.

If you leave OperationClass empty, the value of OperationType can be an SQL statement of any query language.

If you leave OperationClass and OperationType empty, all types of SQL statements are returned
parameters.help_zh:
执行SQL的类型。

如果设置了OperationClass参数，则OperationType的值必须属于对应的语言类型。例如OperationClass的值为DQL，则OperationType的值必须为DQL类型的SQL，例如SELECT。
如果没有设置OperationClass参数，则OperationType的值可以是任意类型SQL。
如果没有设置OperationClass参数也没有设置OperationType参数，则表示返回所有类型SQL
parameters.name: operation_type

parameters.help_en: The maximum amount of time consumed by a slow query. Unit: seconds. Minimum value: 0
parameters.help_zh: 慢SQL最大耗时，取值需大于等于0，单位为秒（s）
parameters.name: max_execute_cost

parameters.help_en: The minimum amount of time consumed by a slow query. Unit: seconds. Minimum value: 0
parameters.help_zh: 慢SQL最小耗时，取值需大于等于0，单位为秒（s）
